rationale: This instrument shows extreme illiquidity and erratic price behavior — the last five 5-minute candles have near-zero volume (131–891 shares), single-tick candles with no range, and a 223 bps bid-ask spread, making reliable entry and exit nearly impossible without significant slippage. The stock gapped up 17.65% and has already collapsed from a high of $7.74 to $5.83 (currently at only 14.3% of today's range), sitting well below the 5-min VWAP of $6.90, suggesting the momentum has exhausted — but the lack of any news context, no relative volume benchmark, and the frozen/illiquid tape provide no reliable directional edge in either direction. The risk of adverse fills and inability to manage a stop precisely in this microstructure outweighs any potential setup.
